task: Restore seamless SSO on Kakao for Kubernetes Dashboard, Grafana, Gitea (admin) and Headlamp, and make each cause durable in the provisioning and GitOps sources.

events.summary: Four independent causes behind one reported symptom. Changes: bastion dnsmasq systemd drop-in, fail-closed Keycloak client-secret reads in 11-3, Gitea seed site-admin in 12-gitea, a Headlamp APISIX login auto-redirect route, docs and regression checks R283-R286. No RBAC binding, chart version or Keycloak client change.

Dashboard 401: apiserver on master-1 logged 'get keys failed ... lookup keycloak.kakao.narwhal.internal on 169.254.169.253:53: no such host'; bastion dnsmasq was failed since 2026-10-16 06:13 (cannot assign requested address) and port 53 refused. Grafana: token exchange returned unauthorized_client 'Invalid client or Invalid client credentials'; grafana-oidc-secret client_secret had length 0 (also devtools/gitea-oidc-secret). Gitea: user 'admin' auto-registered via X-WEBAUTH-USER with is_admin=false, private repo 404. Headlamp: /config auth_type oidc and /oidc 302 to Keycloak, but v0.42 has no autoLogin (first in v0.46.0).
evidence: test:ssh narwhal-bastion journalctl -u dnsmasq -> FAILED to start up (2026-10-16 06:13:55)
test:kubectl -n monitoring get secret grafana-oidc-secret -> client_secret length 0
test:gitea admin user list -> admin IsAdmin=false

events.summary: Live: restarted bastion dnsmasq with a Restart=on-failure/After=network-online.target drop-in (bind-dynamic conflicts with ubuntu-fan's bind-interfaces, tried and reverted); restored grafana and devtools gitea client secrets from Keycloak and recreated the Grafana pod; promoted Gitea 'admin' to site admin. Source: the same drop-in in setup-bastion-proxy.sh, create_keycloak_client and the velero-ui read fail on an empty secret, 12-gitea.sh seeds the admin user echoing its own source_id, apisix-routes.yaml adds headlamp-login-autoredirect.
